_comment: Orchestrator params for tests/readme-shots.mjs (Configure view): stored values + params_schema as served by the daemon's backlog-orchestrator component.

params_schema.label: Max workers
params_schema.description: simultaneous worker sessions (asleep excluded) — 0 = no spawn; a nudge waking a sleeping worker also consumes a slot

params_schema.label: Max active workers
params_schema.description: simultaneous ACTIVE worker sessions — a worker parked on an ac-wait waiter (review, CI checks…) frees an active slot but keeps its max_workers slot; spawn and wake require headroom on both caps; 0 = follows max_workers

params_schema.label: Worker pool
params_schema.description: worker team — one row per profile: count slots + own model/effort/mode (empty = global values); when set, the sum of counts replaces max_workers for worker capacity (max_working still applies); empty = legacy worker_agent + max_workers

params_schema.label: Worker prefix
params_schema.description: worker session title prefix ("Backlog-W") — changing it mid-flight « loses » running workers (their title no longer matches), too short a prefix would adopt foreign sessions (min 4 chars); empty = default

params_schema.label: Worker profile (Backlog-W*)
params_schema.description: `[agents.*]` profile for workers; empty = the agent param

params_schema.label: Worker prompt
params_schema.description: custom worker prompt — empty = built-in prompt; item dispatch (agentbacklog ≥ 0.7) substitutes {WS} {REPO} {ID} {ITEM} {DOD} {BASE} {REVIEW_TRIGGER} {WORKTREE_DIR} {MERGE_RULE} {RULES} and pre-assigns the item (no --pop)

params_schema.label: Planner profile (Backlog-P*)
params_schema.description: `[agents.*]` profile for planners and implementers; empty = the agent param

params_schema.label: Reviewer profile (Backlog-R*)
params_schema.description: `[agents.*]` profile for plan reviewers; empty = the agent param

params_schema.label: Plan→review pipeline
params_schema.description: each no_plan=0 item is planned (Backlog-P*, planner_mode), reviewed by an ephemeral reviewer (Backlog-R*, verdict relayed to the planner), then implemented by the same planner after compact + implement_mode — requires agentbacklog ≥ 0.7; off = direct worker dispatch

params_schema.label: Planner mode
params_schema.description: mode requested at Backlog-P* spawn; empty = the profile's default

params_schema.label: Reviewer mode
params_schema.description: mode requested at Backlog-R* spawn; empty = the profile's default

params_schema.label: Implementation mode
params_schema.description: mode of no_plan item workers and implementers (approved planner or new session); empty = the profile's default

params_schema.label: Planner model
params_schema.description: model requested at Backlog-P* spawn (planners AND implementers); empty = the global model param

params_schema.label: Planner effort
params_schema.description: thought_level applied after Backlog-P* spawn; empty = the global thought_level

params_schema.label: Reviewer model
params_schema.description: model requested at Backlog-R* spawn (plan reviewers); empty = the global model param

params_schema.label: Reviewer effort
params_schema.description: thought_level applied after Backlog-R* spawn; empty = the global thought_level

params_schema.label: Max review rounds
params_schema.description: beyond that, a denied/conditional verdict freezes the item in plan_review « stalled — human review required »

params_schema.label: Plan re-review
params_schema.description: off: a single review round per item — a denied/conditional verdict on round 1 freezes it directly « stalled » (equivalent to max_review_rounds=1)

params_schema.label: Persistent reviewer
params_schema.description: off: a fresh Backlog-R* session each round, deleted after the verdict (pre-reuse behavior)

params_schema.label: PR reviewer profile (PRReview-*)
params_schema.description: `[agents.*]` profile for PR reviewers; empty = the agent param

params_schema.label: Daemon PR review
params_schema.description: trigger comment on an open PR → fresh reviewer session on the exact head, « ## Verdict: … » posted by the daemon — opt-in (replaces missing/dead external automation)

params_schema.label: PR re-review
params_schema.description: off: one review per PR — triggers after a review settled done are ignored (failed stays replayable)

params_schema.label: PR review trigger
params_schema.description: bare trigger comment (exact body); author must be OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR

params_schema.label: PR reviewer mode
params_schema.description: mode requested at PRReview-<N> spawn; empty = the profile's default

params_schema.label: PR reviewer model
params_schema.description: model requested at PRReview-<N> spawn; empty = the global model param

params_schema.label: PR reviewer effort
params_schema.description: thought_level applied after PRReview-<N> spawn; empty = the global thought_level

params_schema.label: Parallel PR reviews
params_schema.description: pool separate from max_workers — workers waiting on a review must not starve reviews

params_schema.label: PR review timeout (s)
params_schema.description: max PR reviewer session duration: kill + post « review failed » beyond it

params_schema.label: Review trigger mode
params_schema.description: when daemon PR reviews fire: comment = bare `pr_review_trigger` comment (default, forge comment scan); auto_open = when the change first shows up open; auto_push = on every head differing from the reviewed sha; manual = acctl pr review / internal RPC only (no forge scan at all); off = nothing, internal requests refused too (in-flight reviews still settle — flip pr_review off to abort them). auto_open/auto_push only review TRUSTED changes — same-repo branch or OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR author (fork/external PRs are skipped, see auto_review_untrusted). Per-repo override via review_overrides

params_schema.label: Auto review untrusted PRs
params_schema.description: trust filter of the auto trigger modes (auto_open/ auto_push): false (default) = a review only launches on a trusted change — same-repo branch OR OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR author; a PR from a fork by an external author never spawns a reviewer session (untrusted changes are remembered, not re-evaluated every tick). true = review everything — risky on public repos. comment mode and internal requests are not filtered. Per-repo override via review_overrides

params_schema.label: PR review prompt
params_schema.description: custom reviewer template — {PR} {REPO} {SHA} {BASE} {WS} {TITLE} {BODY} {TRIGGER} {VERDICT_APPROVED} {VERDICT_CHANGES} {RULES} placeholders; empty = built-in template

params_schema.label: Approve verdict label
params_schema.description: approval heading posted as « ## <label> » — default « Verdict: APPROVED »; the repo's merge policy must accept the chosen label (merge hooks / verdict grep)

params_schema.label: Changes verdict label
params_schema.description: « changes requested » heading posted as « ## <label> » — default « Verdict: CHANGES_REQUESTED »

params_schema.label: Per-repo review overrides
params_schema.description: JSON object {repo_path: {trigger_mode, pr_review_trigger, review_prompt, verdict_approved, verdict_changes, auto_review_untrusted, rules_files}} — key = repo path (owner/name, gerrit project; short name resolves too); same as TOML [backlog_orchestrator.review.<repo>]; empty = global params only

params_schema.label: Enabled at boot
params_schema.description: persisted value — applying it also flips the runtime; `orch on|off` remains the non-persisted runtime toggle

params_schema.label: PR watch
params_schema.description: cycle « gh » probes: retention of workers with an open PR, post-merge recycling, orphan wip release — unchecking = queue only: no forge probe on workers (the release-PR guard falls under auto_patchnotes) and no orphan recovery

params_schema.label: Auto patchnotes
params_schema.description: patchnotes item + ready/draft flip of the release PR when the queue empties/fills

params_schema.label: Proposable Managers
params_schema.description: one Manager per routed workspace (backlog panel section)

params_schema.label: Integration branch
params_schema.description: feature-PR base: PR-review guard and `gh pr list --base` scan, {BASE} prompt placeholder, release-PR head (with release_branch as base); empty = default

params_schema.label: Release branch
params_schema.description: release-PR base (head = integration_branch) — EMPTY = « none » workflow: no release PR is looked up and no head is excluded

params_schema.label: Worktree root
params_schema.description: root dir of the agents' dedicated worktrees — {WORKTREE_DIR} prompt placeholder (the fine naming convention stays with the repo's rules file); empty = default

params_schema.label: Agent merge rule
params_schema.description: text substituted into the {MERGE_RULE} prompt placeholder — EMPTY = prompts defer to the repo's own rules file (agent merges only when its rules allow it, otherwise merge stays with the user)

params_schema.label: Repo rules files
params_schema.description: workspace-relative rule file(s) rendered into the {RULES} prompt placeholder — the first EXISTING file is cited, the rest listed as fallback; per-repo override via review_overrides; empty = default

params_schema.label: Metrics (sampling)
params_schema.description: each tick appends a {ts, pending, wip, workers} sample to ~/.agentbacklog/metrics.jsonl (30d / ~100k samples retention) served by the backlog_metrics RPC; unchecking = no series (item aggregates still computed)

params_schema.label: Cycle period (s)
params_schema.description: tick cadence — effective min 10 s

params_schema.label: Nudge cooldown (s)
params_schema.description: between two relaunches of the same worker

params_schema.label: Sidebar group
params_schema.description: group of spawned sessions — empty = ungrouped

params_schema.label: Worker workspace
params_schema.description: cwd of untagged items and of the orchestrator's CLI calls — tagged items are routed via repo_workspaces; empty = git root of the daemon cwd (rev-parse --show-toplevel), else its cwd

params_schema.label: State directory
params_schema.description: orchestrator state — flock, pause, state.json, plans/, metrics.jsonl, review worktrees; empty = ~/.agentbacklog (every orchestrator of the same queue must share it)

params_schema.label: Agent profile
params_schema.description: `[agents.*]` profile for spawns; empty = first available profile — also the fallback for every `*_agent` left empty

params_schema.label: Spawn mode
params_schema.description: mode requested for spawned sessions; empty = the profile's default

params_schema.label: Spawn model
params_schema.description: model requested for spawned sessions; empty = the profile's default

params_schema.label: Thought level
params_schema.description: applied after each spawn — empty = set nothing

params_schema.label: Manager prompt
params_schema.description: Manager template — placeholders {REPO} {WS} {BASE} {REVIEW_TRIGGER} {WORKTREE_DIR} {MERGE_RULE} {RULES}; empty = built-in template

params_schema.label: Routed workspaces
params_schema.description: « repo=/cwd » entries separated by commas — routes sessions by item repo tag (worker, planner, reviewer, Manager); a tag with no entry = item waiting; empty = default
